advisor_identified: Historian of European and Victorian intellectual history in York University's Department of History and Division of Humanities.

doctorate.title: Frederic Harrison: The Life and Thought of an English Positivist

evidence.says: York's archival biography states that Eisen received a Ph.D. from Johns Hopkins University in 1957, joined York's Department of History and Division of Humanities in 1965, and was a full professor from 1969 to 1993.

A separate York obituary identifies Eisen's specialization as European history, particularly Victorian intellectual history, and states that he earned his doctorate at Johns Hopkins University in 1957.

Johns Hopkins' June 11, 1957 commencement program, printed page 21, lists Sydney Eisen in History under Doctors of Philosophy with the dissertation title Frederic Harrison: The Life and Thought of an English Positivist.

notes: The advisor's documented institution and year match linked AHA record 20087. The commencement program independently confirms the author, field and dissertation; its title uses 'an English Positivist' where the linked record uses 'the English Positivist'.
